name: B10-0522/2026 (S&D) – Condamnation à Macao du militant pour la démocratie et ancien parlementaire Au Kam San
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the case of Au Kam San, a European Union citizen and former lawmaker in Macao who was jailed for 12 years and six months. The Parliament calls for his release, says his trial was politically motivated, and asks the European Union to press China on human rights and the rule of law.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. It is an opinion and a set of requests.
- **Who it affects:** Au Kam San, Macao residents, and European Union relations with China.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament's President sends the text to the Member States, the European Union institutions, China and Macao.
